[[File:WookieeTotem_Dancer.png|thumb|right|200px|A Wookiee totem of a dancer]]
A '''Wookiee totem''' was a small figurine made out of stone which was crafted in the shape of a specific person or of someone performing a specific action, such as [[Entertainer|dancing]]. The [[Myyydril]] tribe within the [[Myyydril Caverns/Legends|Myyydril Caverns]] in the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] were known to craft them.<ref name="Rage of the Wookiees">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>
